AC5 evidence [non-codebase]. This is the first MCP autodeploy after merge: autodeploy logged 'mcp sources changed 23fdf77f94c -> 5029b61749d' at 04:04:11 PDT and cutover at 04:04:36 PDT. Container rebar-mcp-5029b61749df-8093 (image compose-mcp:5029b61749df..., restarts=0) has State.StartedAt 2026-11-01T11:04:32.486Z, and journald shows uvicorn 'Started server process' at 11:04:34.676Z and 'Uvicorn running' at 11:04:34.704Z. That is 2.19 s from container start to web-server start, against the 10 s criterion and 24.4 s on the 2026-11-01 08:57 UTC deploy before the fix. The boot sweep's reducer warnings now come after the listener starts (11:04:36.44 to 11:05:00.19Z), and /health returned 200 at 11:04:36.53Z while the sweep was running.
provenance: environment=AWS account 896586841071 us-east-1, instance i-00880b2c7f13527c5 (rebar-gerrit); principal=frontier profile operator via read-only aws ssm send-command (AWS-RunShellScript: docker inspect, journalctl CONTAINER_NAME=rebar-mcp-5029b61749df-8093, journalctl -u rebar-autodeploy); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read from the production container's own start record and log, which no repository snapshot can replay.
